candidateEvaluations.strategy: Present a streamlined rewards overview focusing immediately on LBG coin balance, tangible cash-equivalent value in local currency, and a direct one-tap statement credit redemption option for bill reduction.
Display rewards balance alongside holiday savings goal progress with linked statement credit allocation controls to satisfy both payment utility and goal tracking motives.
